label: YO! Sushi live Tenkites allergen & nutrition menu (server-rendered HTML)
notes: PREFERRED (live). https://yosushi.com/legal/allergen-information links three Tenkites menus: /yosushi/allergenpageyosushi (restaurants), /yosushi/kiosk02 (Tesco kiosks), /yoireland03 (Ireland - excluded, non-UK). Tenkites renders SERVER-SIDE, so no JSON API and no browser are needed; the GB menu is one ~14MB HTML doc. Each recipe card has <span class='k10-w-recipe__name'> then a k10-recipe__nutrients-table holding a row of k10-recipe__nutrient-name labels and a positionally-aligned row of k10-recipe__nutrient-value cells. TRAPS: the name and its table are NOT in the same container - take the last name occurring BEFORE each table offset; values carry thousands separators ('3,825') that must be stripped or every 4-digit value is lost; the header is 'Energy (kCal)', lowercase k capital C. Restaurant + Tesco kiosk give 165 unique items. FALLBACK, also verified: the official PDF https://yosushi.com/getattachment/1542b7f9-5733-4588-8297-21c764126bad/Allergen-and-Nutritional-Report-December-2022.pdf?lang=en-GB yields 111 items but is dated Dec 2022. generic_pdf.parse_pdf returns 0 on it (text pages, no table objects); parse by regex on name + 12 numbers, kcal=idx0 protein=idx9. All rows pass protein*4<=kcal*1.15.
